app.name: Mèo Đen Convert
app.tagline: Convert images & craft QR codes right on your device — no uploads, no sign-up.

converter.title: Convert image formats
converter.subtitle: HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO, SVG… iPhone photos included — just drag and drop.
converter.dropActive: Let go — the cat's got it!
converter.pasteHint: Tip: paste images directly with Ctrl/⌘ + V

settings.qualityHint: 80–90 is a sweet spot between sharpness and size.
settings.lossless: PNG is lossless — quality is preserved exactly.
settings.backgroundHint: JPG can't be transparent, so transparency is filled with this colour.
settings.lossless_gif: GIF reduces to at most 256 colors — no quality slider.
settings.lossless_ico: Each icon size is stored as lossless PNG.

formatHints.avif: Smallest today, keeps transparency — slower to encode big photos.
formatHints.gif: Up to 256 colors, on/off transparency. Best for simple graphics.
formatHints.bmp: Uncompressed, no transparency — fairly large files.
formatHints.tiff: Uncompressed with transparency — for print/archiving, very large files.
formatHints.ico: Windows icon/favicon with 16–256 px sizes bundled; non-square images are centered on a square.

status.stale: Settings changed — press Convert to redo

errors.decode: Couldn't read this image (corrupt or unsupported by the browser)

resize.title: Resize
resize.hint_max: Shrink so the longest side fits this value — smaller images are left alone, never upscaled.
resize.hint_percent: Scale down by percentage, keeping the aspect ratio.

notes.gifFirstFrame: Animated GIF: only the first frame is used.

qr.title: Create & customize QR codes
qr.subtitle: Links, WiFi, contact cards, SMS… pick colors, dot styles, add a logo — all on your device.

geo.label: Place name (optional)
geo.locateError: Couldn't get your location — check location permissions.

style.logoInvalid: That file isn't a valid image.
style.logoEcl: With a logo, error correction is raised to H so the code still scans.
style.eclHint: Higher survives scratches and covering better, but makes the code denser.

preview.label: QR code preview
preview.empty: Enter some content to make a code
preview.overflow: Too much content for one QR code — try shortening it.
preview.unreadable: Hard to scan — raise contrast or shrink the logo
preview.lowContrast: Dots and background are too similar; scanners may fail.
preview.inverted: Light dots on a dark background — some scanner apps can't read that.

export.copyFail: Your browser won't let me copy images 😿
export.svgHint: SVG is vector — sharp at any print size.

cat.label: Tủm — the black cat mascot. Click to pet.

error: Hmm… this one's a tough nut
present: Pretty, right? Give it a scan!

intro: I'm the black cat looking after this place — your images are processed right here on your device, never uploaded.
Click me for a pet! Now drop some images, or try the QR Code tab.

footer.privacy: 100% in-browser. Your images never leave your device.

pwa.update: A new version of Mèo Đen Convert is available.

pwa.offline: You're offline — everything still runs on your device.
